# Family Filter TV

> Family Filter TV is a profanity filter for Android TV, Android TV boxes and Android phones.
> It works with supported Stremio playback to automatically mute unwanted language while the
> picture keeps playing. Families choose how strict the filter should be and can manage linked TVs
> from an Android phone.

Official site: https://familyfiltertv.com/

## What it does

- Automatically mutes profanity in supported playback.
- Keeps the picture playing; it does not cut or skip the video.
- Supports off, mild, family and strict filter levels.
- Lets one household manage linked TVs from a phone.
- Runs on Android TV, Android TV boxes and Android phones.
- Works with supported Stremio playback.

## What it does not do

- It is not a streaming library and does not provide films, series or subscription access.
- It does not currently filter violence or nudity.
- Filtering availability varies by title, and the app tells the viewer when filtering is unavailable.
- It does not currently filter playback inside subscription streaming apps.

## Price

US$14.99 a year with a 14-day free trial. Google Play shows and charges the local listed price.
Three devices are included; additional device options are available up to six total devices.

A launch discount starts 1 October 2026 for the first 200 subscribers in South Africa and the first
200 elsewhere, then steps down by tier until 31 December 2026.

Subscribers can invite friends from the app. A successful subscribing referral earns account credit,
and the invited friend receives a longer free trial.

## Devices

Android TVs, Android TV boxes and Android phones. Direct installation is available for supported
TV boxes that do not offer Google Play.

## Not affiliated

Family Filter TV is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to
Stremio, Google, or any streaming service.
